rene_loup_arcemont_party_animal.name: René "Loup" Arcemont: Party Animal
rene_loup_arcemont_party_animal.text: The first time each turn you trash a card you are accessing, gain 1[credit] and draw 1 card.

wildcat_strike.name: Wildcat Strike
wildcat_strike.text:
Resolve 1 of the following of the Corp's choice:
- Gain 6[credit].
- Draw 4 cards.

carnivore.name: Carnivore
carnivore.text:
+1[mu]
Access → **Trash 2 cards from your grip:** Trash the card you are accessing. Use this ability only once per turn.
Limit 1 **console** per player.

botulus.name: Botulus
botulus.text:
Install only on a piece of ice.
When you install this program and when your turn begins, place 1 virus counter on this program.
**Hosted virus counter:** Break 1 subroutine on host ice.

buzzsaw.name: Buzzsaw
buzzsaw.text:
Interface → **1[credit]:** Break up to 2 **code gate** subroutines.
**3[credit]:** +1 strength.

cleaver.name: Cleaver
cleaver.text:
Interface → **1[credit]:** Break up to 2 **barrier** subroutines.
**2[credit]:** +1 strength.

fermenter.name: Fermenter
fermenter.text:
When you install this program and when your turn begins, place 1 virus counter on this program.
[click], [trash]**:** Gain 2[credit] for each hosted virus counter.

leech.name: Leech
leech.text:
Whenever you make a successful run on a central server, place 1 virus counter on this program.
**Hosted virus counter:** The ice you are encountering gets -1 strength for the remainder of this encounter.

cookbook.name: Cookbook
cookbook.text: Whenever you install a **virus** program, you may place 1 virus counter on it.

zahya_sadeghi_versatile_smuggler.name: Zahya Sadeghi: Versatile Smuggler
zahya_sadeghi_versatile_smuggler.text: Whenever a run on HQ or R&D ends, you may gain 1[credit] for each time you accessed a card during that run. Use this ability only once per turn.

mutual_favor.name: Mutual Favor
mutual_favor.text: Search your stack for 1 **icebreaker** program and reveal it. *(Shuffle your stack after searching it.)* If you made a successful run this turn, you may install it. If you do not, add it to your grip.

tread_lightly.name: Tread Lightly
tread_lightly.text: Run any server. During that run, the rez cost of each piece of ice is increased by 3[credit].

docklands_pass.name: Docklands Pass
docklands_pass.text: The first time each turn you breach HQ, access 1 additional card.

pennyshaver.name: Pennyshaver
pennyshaver.text:
+1[mu]
Whenever you make a successful run, place 1[credit] on this hardware.
[click]**:** Place 1[credit] on this hardware, then take all credits from it.
Limit 1 **console** per player.

carmen.name: Carmen
carmen.text:
If you made a successful run this turn, this program costs 2[credit] less to install.
Interface → **1[credit]:** Break 1 **sentry** subroutine.
**2[credit]:** +3 strength.

marjanah.name: Marjanah
marjanah.text:
Interface → **2[credit]:** Break 1 **barrier** subroutine. If you made a successful run this turn, this ability costs 1[credit] less to use.
**1[credit]:** +1 strength.

tranquilizer.name: Tranquilizer
tranquilizer.text:
Install only on a piece of ice.
When you install this program and when your turn begins, place 1 virus counter on this program. Then, if there are 3 or more hosted virus counters, derez host ice.

red_team.name: Red Team
red_team.text:
When you install this resource, load 12[credit] onto it. When it is empty, trash it.
[click]**:** Run a central server you have not run this turn. If successful, take 3[credit] from this resource.

tao_salonga_telepresence_magician.name: Tāo Salonga: Telepresence Magician
tao_salonga_telepresence_magician.text: Whenever an agenda is scored or stolen, you may swap 2 installed pieces of ice.

creative_commission.name: Creative Commission
creative_commission.text: Gain 5[credit]. If you have any [click] remaining, lose [click].

vrcation.name: VRcation
vrcation.text: Draw 4 cards. If you have any [click] remaining, lose [click].

dzmz_optimizer.name: DZMZ Optimizer
dzmz_optimizer.text:
+1[mu]
The first program you install each turn costs 1[credit] less to install.

pantograph.name: Pantograph
pantograph.text:
+1[mu]
Whenever an agenda is scored or stolen, gain 1[credit]. Then, you may install 1 card from your grip.
Limit 1 **console** per player.

conduit.name: Conduit
conduit.text:
Whenever a successful run on R&D ends, you may place 1 virus counter on this program.
[click]**:** Run R&D. If successful, access X additional cards when you breach R&D. X is equal to the number of hosted virus counters.

echelon.name: Echelon
echelon.text:
This program gets +1 strength for each installed **icebreaker** *(including this one)*.
Interface → **1[credit]:** Break 1 **sentry** subroutine.
**3[credit]:** +2 strength.

unity.name: Unity
unity.text:
Interface → **1[credit]:** Break 1 **code gate** subroutine.
**1[credit]:** +1 strength for each installed **icebreaker** *(including this one)*.

telework_contract.name: Telework Contract
telework_contract.text:
When you install this resource, load 9[credit] onto it. When it is empty, trash it.
[click]**:** Take 3[credit] from this resource. Use this ability only once per turn.

jailbreak.name: Jailbreak
jailbreak.text: Run HQ or R&D. If successful, draw 1 card and when you breach the attacked server, access 1 additional card.

overclock.name: Overclock
overclock.text: Place 5[credit] on this event, then run any server. You can spend hosted credits during that run.

mayfly.name: Mayfly
mayfly.text:
Interface → **1[credit]:** Break 1 subroutine. When this run ends, trash this program.
**1[credit]:** +1 strength.

smartware_distributor.name: Smartware Distributor
smartware_distributor.text:
[click]**:** Place 3[credit] on this resource.
When your turn begins, take 1[credit] from this resource.

verbal_plasticity.name: Verbal Plasticity
verbal_plasticity.text: The first time each turn you take the basic action to draw 1 card, instead draw 2 cards.

haas_bioroid_precision_design.name: Haas-Bioroid: Precision Design
haas_bioroid_precision_design.text:
You get +1 maximum hand size.
Whenever you score an agenda, you may add 1 card from Archives to HQ.

luminal_transubstantiation.name: Luminal Transubstantiation
luminal_transubstantiation.text:
When you score this agenda, gain [click][click][click]. You cannot score agendas for the remainder of the turn.
Limit 1 per deck.

nico_campaign.name: Nico Campaign
nico_campaign.text:
When you rez this asset, load 9[credit] onto it. When it is empty, trash it and draw 1 card.
When your turn begins, take 3[credit] from this asset.

ansel_1_0.name: Ansel 1.0
ansel_1_0.text:
**Lose [click]:** Break 1 subroutine on this ice. Only the Runner can use this ability.
[subroutine] Trash 1 installed Runner card.
[subroutine] You may install 1 card from HQ or Archives.
[subroutine] The Runner cannot steal or trash Corp cards for the remainder of this run.

bran_1_0.name: Brân 1.0
bran_1_0.text:
**Lose [click]:** Break 1 subroutine on this ice. Only the Runner can use this ability.
[subroutine] You may install 1 piece of ice from HQ or Archives directly inward from this ice, ignoring all costs.
[subroutine] End the run.
[subroutine] End the run.

seamless_launch.name: Seamless Launch
seamless_launch.text: Place 2 advancement counters on 1 installed card that you did not install this turn.

sprint.name: Sprint
sprint.text: Draw 3 cards. Shuffle 2 cards from HQ into R&D.

manegarm_skunkworks.name: Manegarm Skunkworks
manegarm_skunkworks.text: Whenever the Runner approaches this server, end the run unless they either spend [click][click] or pay 5[credit].

jinteki_restoring_humanity.name: Jinteki: Restoring Humanity
jinteki_restoring_humanity.text: When your discard phase ends, if there is a facedown card in Archives, gain 1[credit].

longevity_serum.name: Longevity Serum
longevity_serum.text:
When you score this agenda, trash any number of cards from HQ. Shuffle up to 3 cards from Archives into R&D.
Limit 1 per deck.

urtica_cipher.name: Urtica Cipher
urtica_cipher.text:
You can advance this asset.
When the Runner accesses this asset while it is installed, do 2 net damage plus 1 net damage for each hosted advancement counter.

diviner.name: Diviner
diviner.text: [subroutine] Do 1 net damage. If you trash a card with a printed play or install cost that is an odd number, end the run. *(0 is not odd.)*

karuna.name: Karunā
karuna.text:
[subroutine] Do 2 net damage. The Runner may jack out.
[subroutine] Do 2 net damage.

hansei_review.name: Hansei Review
hansei_review.text: Gain 10[credit]. If there are any cards in HQ, trash 1 of them.

neurospike.name: Neurospike
neurospike.text: Do X net damage, where X is equal to the sum of the printed agenda points on agendas you scored this turn.

anoetic_void.name: Anoetic Void
anoetic_void.text: Whenever the Runner approaches this server, you may pay 2[credit] and trash 2 cards from HQ. If you do, end the run.

nbn_reality_plus.name: NBN: Reality Plus
nbn_reality_plus.text: The first time each turn the Runner takes a tag, gain 2[credit] or draw 2 cards.

tomorrows_headline.name: Tomorrow's Headline
tomorrows_headline.text:
When this agenda is scored or stolen, give the Runner 1 tag.
Limit 1 per deck.

spin_doctor.name: Spin Doctor
spin_doctor.text:
When you rez this asset, draw 2 cards.
**Remove this asset from the game:** Shuffle up to 2 cards from Archives into R&D.

funhouse.name: Funhouse
funhouse.text:
When the Runner encounters this ice, end the run unless the Runner takes 1 tag.
[subroutine] Give the Runner 1 tag unless they pay 4[credit].

ping.name: Ping
ping.text:
When you rez this ice during a run against this server, give the Runner 1 tag.
[subroutine] End the run.

predictive_planogram.name: Predictive Planogram
predictive_planogram.text:
Resolve 1 of the following. If the Runner is tagged, you may resolve both instead.
- Gain 3[credit].
- Draw 3 cards.

public_trail.name: Public Trail
public_trail.text:
Play only if the Runner made a successful run during their last turn.
Give the Runner 1 tag unless they pay 8[credit].

amaze_amusements.name: AMAZE Amusements
amaze_amusements.text: Persistent → Whenever a run on this server ends, if the Runner stole any agendas during that run, give the Runner 2 tags. *(If the Runner trashes this card while accessing it, this ability still applies for the remainder of this run.)*

weyland_consortium_built_to_last.name: Weyland Consortium: Built to Last
weyland_consortium_built_to_last.text: Whenever you advance a card, gain 2[credit] if it had no advancement counters.

above_the_law.name: Above the Law
above_the_law.text:
When you score this agenda, you may trash 1 installed resource.
Limit 1 per deck.

clearinghouse.name: Clearinghouse
clearinghouse.text:
You can advance this asset.
When your turn begins, you may trash this asset to do 1 meat damage for each hosted advancement counter.

ballista.name: Ballista
ballista.text: [subroutine] Trash 1 installed program or end the run.

pharos.name: Pharos
pharos.text:
You can advance this ice. It gets +5 strength while there are 3 or more hosted advancement counters.
[subroutine] Give the Runner 1 tag.
[subroutine] End the run.
[subroutine] End the run.

retribution.name: Retribution
retribution.text:
Play only if the Runner is tagged.
Trash 1 installed program or piece of hardware.

malapert_data_vault.name: Malapert Data Vault
malapert_data_vault.text: Whenever you score an agenda from this server, you may search R&D for 1 non-agenda card and reveal it. *(Shuffle R&D after searching it.)* Add that card to HQ.

offworld_office.name: Offworld Office
offworld_office.text: When you score this agenda, gain 7[credit].

orbital_superiority.name: Orbital Superiority
orbital_superiority.text: When you score this agenda, if the Runner is tagged, do 4 meat damage; otherwise, give the Runner 1 tag.

send_a_message.name: Send a Message
send_a_message.text: When this agenda is scored or stolen, you may rez 1 installed piece of ice, ignoring all costs.

superconducting_hub.name: Superconducting Hub
superconducting_hub.text:
When you score this agenda, you may draw 2 cards.
You get +2 maximum hand size.

regolith_mining_license.name: Regolith Mining License
regolith_mining_license.text:
When you rez this asset, load 15[credit] onto it. When it is empty, trash it.
[click]**:** Take 3[credit] from this asset.

palisade.name: Palisade
palisade.text:
While this ice is protecting a remote server, it gets +2 strength.
[subroutine] End the run.

whitespace.name: Whitespace
whitespace.text:
[subroutine] The Runner loses 3[credit].
[subroutine] If the Runner has 6[credit] or less, end the run.

p_wildcat_strike_sg.flavor_text: They can buy off union leadership, but they can't stop us walking out!

p_carnivore_sg.flavor_text:
"It hungers to sink teeth into problems."
—Loup

p_fermenter_sg.flavor_text:
"There's a tension to a cook. Each processing cycle sweetens the pot and raises the heat. I stir all night, but few have my appetite for danger."
—René "Loup" Arcemont

p_leech_sg.flavor_text: The greediest bloodsucker this side of a corporate boardroom.

p_cookbook_sg.flavor_text:
"It waits on an unlabelled memstrip far below the deepest hab. Angry, desperate souls seek it out, hungry for power to change a brutal world. Once they can stomach no more bitter revenge, they return to that nameless tunnel, the book a recipe thicker."
—Heinlein urban legend

p_mutual_favor_sg.flavor_text: The real reward is the friends you make along the way.

p_tread_lightly_sg.flavor_text:
"A mirrorfiber mod or high-end mantle can be helpful, but nothing beats a good dose of 'keeping your damn head down.'"
—"G0ph3r" O'Ryan

p_docklands_pass_sg.flavor_text: Zahya knows the keeper of every door between the Docklands and the Domes. More importantly, she knows their price.

p_pennyshaver_sg.flavor_text: "Braggarts chase big heists. Patience enriches skimming fractions of a credit at a time." —Zahya

p_carmen_sg.flavor_text:
The whole wide world your domain
For law your own free will.

p_marjanah_sg.flavor_text:
"You can't rule a kingdom by standing still."
—Zahya Sadeghi

p_red_team_sg.flavor_text: The Domes of Heinlein are a pressure cooker of cutthroat capitalism. Prospective employers rarely have time for background checks.

p_tao_salonga_telepresence_magician_sg.flavor_text: Sufficient skill is indistinguishable from magic.

p_creative_commission_sg.flavor_text: The challenge of my art is what I live for, but I'm not going to say no to a patron with taste.

p_vrcation_sg.flavor_text:
"You know there's no water in the Sea of Tranquility, right?"
"That doesn't mean there's no beach."

p_dzmz_optimizer_sg.flavor_text: Tāo exhaled, the med-exoskeleton faithfully stabilizing him. In that absent breath, he reached through layers of waldos and optimizers and plucked the errant molecule from the chip.

p_pantograph_sg.flavor_text:
"With this beautiful baby I can juggle simultaneous runs by haptic feedback alone!"
—Tāo

p_conduit_sg.flavor_text:
A dabbling with truth is a pernicious dream
Drink deep, or taste not the raw datastream.

p_echelon_sg.flavor_text: The beauty of open projects—each stands atop past success.

p_unity_sg.flavor_text: The joy of handcrafted code—each fits perfectly within the whole.

p_telework_contract_sg.flavor_text:
"For all I know, I could spend a shift digging next to old Weyland himself."
—Lane

p_jailbreak_sg.flavor_text:
"We'll take the access codes from their own prisec—privilege escalation through local application of force."
—The Catalyst

p_overclock_sg.flavor_text:
"After 381FS4 started acting independently, all bets were off. Rethreading its own brain chip... even probing **our** nodes. I had to shut it down."
—Linus Lovegood, NBN Novelties&Acquisitions

p_sure_gamble_sg.flavor_text: Anyone can put in the hours of planning, practice, and preparation—but making it all look like luck takes **style**.

p_t400_memory_diamond_sg.flavor_text: LLDS still holds the patent, but good tech attracts knockoffs.

p_mayfly_sg.flavor_text: Compiling even the smallest AI takes weeks for only seconds of runtime, but that brief, shining moment allows... **everything**.

p_smartware_distributor_sg.flavor_text: The beauty of 22nd-century tech: if it still functions after all these decades, you know the build quality is solid.

p_verbal_plasticity_sg.flavor_text:
"Some kids got g-mods for beauty, sports, or staying up all night. My parents thought Broca-mods were cool. Hah. Fluent in ten languages so far, and still searching for the words to thank them."
—Patrick Blue, Solar Artist

p_luminal_transubstantiation_sg.flavor_text: We are the light of tomorrow.

p_nico_campaign_sg.flavor_text: Haas thinks they're making a new line of androgynous products. In truth, they're making us thousands of new siblings to free.

p_seamless_launch_sg.flavor_text: The first lesson for handling bioroids is simple: they must not be allowed to feel.

p_manegarm_skunkworks_sg.flavor_text:
"Whose memory-tape needs such stringent security?"
—The Catalyst

p_urtica_cipher_sg.flavor_text: A novel spin-off of Chronos tech was admixing sensitive data with ethically-sourced brain images of injured staff. Few intruders can handle a thousand years of skin burns in one moment.

p_diviner_sg.flavor_text: It reads your future in a single biometric sweep.

p_karuna_sg.flavor_text: You did not escape, you were shown mercy.

p_hansei_review_sg.flavor_text:
"Constant self-reflection is the key to excellence. We remember failed ideas, but do not carry them forward."
—Director Kase, unknown leadership seminar

p_neurospike_sg.flavor_text: Macroscale developments within the Net decouple the prior informational states—surplus entropy is then gifted where it will do the most good.

p_anoetic_void_sg.flavor_text:
The self-evolving Net twists into spaces unthought and unthinkable: realms of gods and other infohazards, mocking our sacrifices to petty causality.
—Conceptual Frameworks for Applied Theology

p_tomorrows_headline_sg.flavor_text: We don't find news. We make it.

p_spin_doctor_sg.flavor_text: "It's worse than dead meat—your project is too toxic to even feed to the vultures! If you don't want to **join** it in the bloody memory hole, crawl onto every business show you can and wallow in blame like a pig in muck."

p_funhouse_sg.flavor_text:
"I might take a break from VR after this one."
—SeaOfRibaldry, sensie streamer

p_ping_sg.flavor_text:
AvID:??:73.174 time=0.632 ms
AvID:??:73.174 time=0.201 ms
AvID:??:73.174 time=0.000 ms **ALERT**

p_predictive_planogram_sg.flavor_text: For the best augmented reality shopping experience, please disable tracking protection.

p_public_trail_sg.flavor_text:
"A runner uses significant resources scrubbing their traces. Every cycle, it's harder to pin them down. But the game changes. In Heinlein, no one can last a day without brushing **our** AR-network."
—Cassie LaRosa, Lunar NetDefense Sysop

p_above_the_law_sg.flavor_text: We are judge, jury, and executioner.

p_clearinghouse_sg.flavor_text:
"First rule of the business: make sure you're not 'personally liable' when the transaction executes."
—Ted J. Son, Central Counterparty Clearance

p_ballista_sg.flavor_text:
"Puts a hole in your rig **and** your plans."
—René "Loup" Arcemont

p_government_subsidy_sg.flavor_text:
"If the government spent 1% of the funding they provide us tracking where the other 99% went, my colleagues and I would be in prison…
…but that is a very big **if**."
—Huey DeMora, W-Con public-private facilitation seminar

p_retribution_sg.flavor_text: Did you really think you'd get away with it?

p_malapert_data_vault_sg.flavor_text: Sunlight does not touch the Crater of Eternal Darkness, a fitting abode for the Consortium's malefic secrets.

p_offworld_office_sg.flavor_text: As the first lunar city, Heinlein was built on the dreams of a new frontier and boundless opportunity, but He3 mining is too lucrative for the corps to ever relinquish control.

p_orbital_superiority_sg.flavor_text: Mobsters bribe police, megacorps acquire militaries.

p_send_a_message_sg.flavor_text: It might be over, but we **will** get them next time.

p_superconducting_hub_sg.flavor_text: With Earth-Luna communications, saving microseconds returns megacredits.

p_regolith_mining_license_sg.flavor_text:
"The economy of three worlds is sustained by He3 extraction from the lunar surface. The very fulcrum of power, the key to collective survival—auctioned to the highest bidder."
—The Catalyst

p_tithe_sg.flavor_text:
"You'll give till it hurts... then it'll reach for more."
—Red Comyn

p_hedge_fund_sg.flavor_text: A financial instrument for diverting money from those outside to those inside.

p_the_catalyst_convention_breaker_sg.flavor_text: Are you ready to start something big?

p_the_syndicate_profit_over_principle_sg.flavor_text: You work for us. You just don't know it yet.
